newsitem.title: USA: Regal to buy Cobb Theatres in $200 mln deal.
newsitem.headline: Regal to buy Cobb Theatres in $200 mln deal.

text.p: Regal Cinemas Inc said Wednesday that it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Cobb Theatres in a deal valued at $200 million.
The company said it would pay $100 million in stock and assume $100 million in debt to acquire the privately-held company, which operates 643 screens in 67 theatres in the South.

Regal said the deal will be accounted for as a pooling of interests. Consummation is subject, among other things, to customary closing conditions and the expiration of the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Act. Regal said it expects the transaction to be completed by the end of July.
The company said that after the acquisition, it will have 2,076 screens in operation at 235 theatre locations.
